components.name: Separator
components.description: Separator — divides content without borders on surfaces. Line = border/hairline (1px), Block = 8px bg/base band between grouped sections, Labeled = line · text · line ("or"). Inset: None | Leading 16 | Both 16. Prefer colour steps between surfaces; use a separator only inside one surface.

DATA DISPLAY
BEK
Design System
4.13 Separator
A thin line, a band or a labelled line that divides content inside one surface. 6 variants · Type × Orientation × Inset.
Overview
BEK separates layers by colour first. Use a separator only between items that share one surface.
Line
1px border/hairline — between rows of one list.
Line · Leading inset
Starts after the 16px leading inset — aligns with row text.
Block
8px bg/base band — between groups on mobile.
Labeled
or
Line · text · line — “or” between two ways to continue.
Vertical
24px — between inline actions or meta items.
Anatomy
Labeled separator shown; Line and Block have a single layer.

Devices
Same component on every device; only inset and usage change.
Mobile · 390
Leading inset 16 under list rows. Block between groups.
Tablet · 834
or
Line inside cards; prefer surface steps between cards — Block is rarely needed.
Web · 1440
Hairline only inside tables, menus and sidebars. Never between page sections — use spacing.
Do / Don’t
Do
Use a leading-inset line between rows of one list so it aligns with the text.
Don’t
Don’t stack separators or put one between two surfaces of different colour — the colour step already separates them.
